Maya Chen: quick heads-up — perf spike on H100 tail during the last canary. profiling shows kernel-selector flip at ~64 token windows + heavy KV fragmentation. thinking we should rebalance batch-token ceilings across card classes and tweak queue policy.
Jamal Ortiz: can you paste the profile snippet? where's the flip coming from (softmax kernel or kv path)?
Maya Chen: pasted a short snippet below:
```
kv_cache_hits: 0.87
avg_seq_len: 432
h100_tail_p95_latency: +18ms
kernel_selected: matmul_v2 -> matmul_v1 (when seq>512)
batch_token_ceiling: H100=12288 A100=8192 A10=6144 L4=2048 T4=1024
```
Maya Chen: hypothesis: for long-ish requests the kernel selector falls back to an older matmul kernel on H100 which increases memory working set and triggers kv fragmentation -> higher p95. Also our current H100 ceiling is high so mixing long sequences causes big slices that fragment the KV cache.
Alex Rivera: agree. we should try two levers: 1) lower max_tokens_per_batch on H100 for seq_len>512, 2) introduce a small 'kv-frag' penalty in the queue policy that prefers batching long-seq requests on A100/A10 instead when available.
Sara Patel: can we be surgical? e.g. runtime config:
```
batch_rules:
  - when: avg_seq_len > 512
    override:
      H100.max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
      H100.max_batch_items: 6
  - when: kv_frag_score > 0.7
    route_preference: [A100, A10, H100]
```
Jamal Ortiz: that looks good. also add metric gate so we revert if p95 improves but throughput drops >3%.
Maya Chen: proposed experiment plan:
- canary group (5%): apply rules above + soft kv_penalty=0.2
- measure p50/p95, throughput, kernel_flip_count, kv_free_frag
- run 2 hours at peak and 4 hours low traffic
Alex Rivera: small nit: set min_batch_size for L4 to 8 to avoid small-batch kernel path. L4's small batch kernels are cheap but vectorization suffers under 4.
Sara Patel: ack. add to plan: L4.min_batch_size=8 and T4.min_batch_size=4.
ops-bot: deploy request queued: canary-config/batchshape-rebalance -> staging -> canary-5pct
ci-bot: canary config lint OK. rolling to canary-5pct at 2026-03-20T18:24:00Z
Jamal Ortiz: once canary is live, capture kernel_selector histogram + per-card kv_free_frag metric every 30s. set alert if h100.p95 > baseline+12ms
Maya Chen: also add regression eval for a set of 20 long prompts we saw during repro. if model quality changes, abort.
Alex Rivera: if we see throughput degradation >2% on H100 but p95 improves, consider moving some long sequences to A10 via routing rather than reducing H100 ceiling further.
Sara Patel: question: how will this interact with autoscale? if H100 becomes less utilized we might autoscale down and push more load to A100 — that's ok but need to track cost delta.
Maya Chen: noted. include cost delta in experiment dashboard.
Jamal Ortiz: TL;DR: do canary with H100 ceiling reduced on long seq, kv-aware queue penalty, bump L4/T4 min_batch_size. metrics: p50/p95, flip_count, kv_frag, throughput, cost-delta, model-quality-evals. revert thresholds in ops-runbook.
Maya Chen: thanks. I'll open a short PR for the runtime rule + dashboard panels and tag you all. :thumbsup:
Alex Rivera: thanks — i'll prep the kernel_selector hist capture script.
ci-bot: canary deployed to 5% at 2026-03-20T18:27:41Z — monitoring enabled.
Maya Chen: good to close here once PR merged and canary finishes. will post results tomorrow.
